description: Presidential Secretariate - Essential Public Service for the Purpose of the Community
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President declaring certain services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. This constitutes a regulatory action that modifies the legal framework for public services, specifically defining what constitutes "essential public services" for regulatory purposes. While it mentions the President by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or structural reorganization, nor does it assign detailed portfolio responsibilities to the President. The content primarily establishes legal/regulatory definitions and requirements, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
